title_youtube: a blue whale doesn't care if you recycle
description_youtube:
Recycling won't save you from a falling blue whale. The good-citizen test, settled by the largest animal that ever lived.

The useless facts:
- Blue whales can reach about 100 feet long (up to ~110 ft in the Antarctic) and weigh more than 330,000 pounds, according to NOAA Fisheries.
- That is roughly three school buses end to end.
- Rinsing your cans and sorting plastic by number is still a good idea. It's just not whale-proof.

Useless Facts is our series of true facts nobody needed. Be honest: do you rinse your cans?

Sources:
- NOAA Fisheries, Blue Whale (Antarctic blue whales up to about 110 ft and more than 330,000 lb): https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/species/blue-whale
- Alaska Department of Fish and Game, Blue whale (southern hemisphere up to 100 ft and more than 330,000 lb): https://www.adfg.alaska.gov/static/education/wns/blue_whale.pdf
